name: FPL Brief — Night Match Analysis Desk
direction: A private, calm, evidence-led FPL decision desk. Prioritize league context, actionable decisions, and readable supporting data.
typography: Inter, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; tabular numerals for scores and prices.
layout: Persistent desktop league rail and wide analysis canvas; compact screens collapse to a horizontal section rail.
principles: Use hierarchy and spacing instead of a wall of interchangeable cards.
Pair status colors with explicit labels and keep contrast high.
Keep data tables horizontally scrollable on narrow screens.
Respect reduced motion and keyboard focus.
